name: patient_sex_is_male_now

when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years

name: octreotide_lar_dose_value_recorded_chronic_treatment_with_unit_mg

when_unknown: Set to null if the dose of octreotide LAR in mg during chronic treatment is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the octreotide LAR dose in milligrams (mg) administered to the patient during chronic treatment.

when_value: Set to the numeric value of the duration in months of chronic treatment with octreotide LAR for the patient.

name: patient_has_chronic_treatment_with_octreotide_lar
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has had chronic treatment with octreotide long acting release (LAR).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has had chronic treatment with octreotide long acting release (LAR).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not had chronic treatment with octreotide long acting release (LAR).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has had chronic treatment with octreotide long acting release (LAR).

name: patient_has_partial_responsiveness_to_octreotide_lar_monotherapy_within_6_months
meaning: Indicates whether the patient meets the definition of partial responsiveness to octreotide LAR monotherapy within 6 months as specified in the criterion.
when_true: Set to true if, at any one point within the 6 months of monotherapy with 30 mg/month octreotide LAR, the patient experienced both a decrease in growth hormone of at least 25% and a decrease in insulin-like growth factor 1 of at least 25% compared to pre-monotherapy values.
when_false: Set to false if the above is not true.
when_unknown: Set to null if the information is unavailable or cannot be determined.

name: growth_hormone_value_recorded_during_monotherapy_with_unit_ng_per_ml
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's growth hormone level at any one point during octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.
when_unknown: Set to null if the growth hormone value during monotherapy is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's growth hormone level measured at any one point during the 6 months of octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.

name: growth_hormone_value_recorded_pre_monotherapy_with_unit_ng_per_ml
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's growth hormone level prior to octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.
when_unknown: Set to null if the pre-monotherapy growth hormone value is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's growth hormone level measured prior to starting octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.

name: insulin_like_growth_factor_1_value_recorded_during_monotherapy_with_unit_ng_per_ml
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's IGF-1 level at any one point during octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.
when_unknown: Set to null if the IGF-1 value during monotherapy is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's IGF-1 level measured at any one point during the 6 months of octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.

name: insulin_like_growth_factor_1_value_recorded_pre_monotherapy_with_unit_ng_per_ml

when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's IGF-1 level measured prior to starting octreotide LAR monotherapy, in ng/mL.

name: patient_growth_hormone_nadir_value_after_75g_ogtt_within_4_weeks_prior_to_visit_1_withunit_micrograms_per_liter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's growth hormone nadir after oral administration of 75 grams of glucose (oral glucose tolerance test) measured within 4 weeks prior to visit 1, in micrograms per liter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a numeric measurement of the patient's growth hormone nadir after oral administration of 75 grams of glucose (oral glucose tolerance test) within 4 weeks prior to visit 1 is available, in micrograms per liter.

name: patient_has_lack_of_suppression_of_growth_hormone_nadir_after_75g_ogtt_within_4_weeks_prior_to_visit_1
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has a lack of suppression of growth hormone nadir to less than 1.0 micrograms per liter after oral administration of 75 grams of glucose (oral glucose tolerance test) proven within 4 weeks prior to visit 1.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has a lack of suppression of growth hormone nadir to less than 1.0 micrograms per liter after oral administration of 75 grams of glucose (oral glucose tolerance test) proven within 4 weeks prior to visit 1.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not have a lack of suppression of growth hormone nadir to less than 1.0 micrograms per liter after oral administration of 75 grams of glucose (oral glucose tolerance test) proven within 4 weeks prior to visit 1.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has a lack of suppression of growth hormone nadir to less than 1.0 micrograms per liter after oral administration of 75 grams of glucose (oral glucose tolerance test) proven within 4 weeks prior to visit 1.

name: patient_igf1_value_within_4_weeks_prior_to_visit_1_withunit_micrograms_per_liter
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) level measured within 4 weeks prior to visit 1, in micrograms per liter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such measurement is available or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured value if a numeric measurement of the patient's insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) level within 4 weeks prior to visit 1 is available, in micrograms per liter.

name: patient_igf1_normal_range_adjusted_for_age_and_gender_brabant_2003_withunit_micrograms_per_liter
meaning: Numeric value representing the normal range (mean and standard deviation) for insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), adjusted for age and gender according to Brabant 2003, in micrograms per liter.
when_unknown: Set to null if no such reference value is available or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the normal range value (mean and standard deviation) for IGF-1, adjusted for age and gender according to Brabant 2003, in micrograms per liter, if available.

name: patient_has_acromegaly_symptoms_inadequately_controlled_now_as_judged_by_investigator

when_false: Set to false if the patient's acromegaly symptoms are adequately controlled now, as judged by the investigator using the acromegaly comorbidities and symptom evaluation.

name: patient_has_finding_of_abnormal_igf1_value_within_4_weeks_prior_to_visit_1
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's IGF-1 value within 4 weeks prior to visit 1 is at least 10 percent above the normal value plus or minus 2 standard deviations (adjusted for age and gender; Brabant 2003).
when_true: Set to true if the patient's IGF-1 value within 4 weeks prior to visit 1 is at least 10 percent above the normal value plus or minus 2 standard deviations (adjusted for age and gender; Brabant 2003).
when_false: Set to false if the patient's IGF-1 value within 4 weeks prior to visit 1 is less than 10 percent above the normal value plus or minus 2 standard deviations (adjusted for age and gender; Brabant 2003).
when_unknown: Set to null if the IGF-1 value or the normal range is not available or indeterminate.
